<?php

namespace Acme\Plugin\AlfaPayments\Offline\Extension;

use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Plugin\PaymentsPlugin;
use Joomla\CMS\Factory;
use Joomla\CMS\Language\Text;
use Joomla\CMS\Log\Log;

\defined('_JEXEC') or die;

final class Offline extends PaymentsPlugin
{
    /**
     * Staff may place an order with this method: it needs no shopper, no browser and no provider.
     */
    public function supportsOperatorPlacement(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    public function onItemView($event): void
    {
        $event->setLayout('default_item_view');
        $event->setLayoutData(['method' => $event->getMethod()]);
    }

    public function onCartView($event): void
    {
        // The layout prints nothing, so nothing is passed to it.
        $event->setLayout('default_cart_view');
        $event->setLayoutData([]);
    }

    public function onOrderAfterPlace($event): void
    {
        $order = $event->getOrder();

        // Only an order this plugin takes.
        if ($this->getPaymentMethod(orderId: $order->id()) === null) {
            return;
        }

        // Nothing left to collect: write no row.
        if ($this->amountToCollect($order) <= 0.000001) {
            return;
        }

        // One pending payment for the amount still to collect.
        $paymentId = $this->payment($order)->pending()->save();

        // The order is already saved, so report and do not throw.
        if (!$paymentId) {
            Log::add('Offline payment: no payment row was created for order #' . $order->id(), Log::ERROR, $this->logCategory());
        }
    }

    public function onOrderProcessView($event): void
    {
        // Offline: nothing to do. The shopper goes straight to the completed page.
    }

    public function onOrderCompleteView($event): void
    {
        $event->setLayout('default_order_completed');
        $event->setLayoutData([]);
    }

    public function onGetActions($event): void
    {
        $payment = $event->getPayment();

        if (($payment->transaction_status ?? '') === self::STATUS_PENDING) {
            $event->add('mark_paid', Text::_('PLG_ALFA_PAYMENTS_OFFLINE_MARK_PAID'))
                ->mutating()
                ->icon('checkmark')->css('btn-success')
                ->confirm(Text::_('PLG_ALFA_PAYMENTS_OFFLINE_CONFIRM_MARK_PAID'))
                ->priority(200);
        }
    }

    public function onExecuteAction($event): void
    {
        $payment = $event->getPayment();

        if ($event->getAction() !== 'mark_paid') {
            $event->setError(Text::sprintf('PLG_ALFA_PAYMENTS_OFFLINE_ERROR_UNKNOWN_ACTION', $event->getAction()));

            return;
        }

        // Only a payment this plugin wrote.
        if ((string) ($payment->payment_method_type ?? '') !== $this->_name) {
            $event->setError(Text::sprintf('PLG_ALFA_PAYMENTS_OFFLINE_ERROR_NOT_OWN', (int) $payment->id));

            return;
        }

        // Changing the row to completed is what moves the order (status_on_completed).
        $saved = $this->paymentUpdate((int) $payment->id)
            ->completed()
            ->processedAt(Factory::getDate('now', 'UTC')->toSql())
            ->save();

        if ($saved === false) {
            $event->setError(Text::sprintf('PLG_ALFA_PAYMENTS_OFFLINE_ERROR_MARK_PAID', (int) $payment->id));

            return;
        }

        $event->setMessage(Text::sprintf('PLG_ALFA_PAYMENTS_OFFLINE_MSG_MARKED_PAID', (int) $payment->id));
        $event->setRefresh(true);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Acme\Plugin\AlfaShipments\Flat\Extension;

use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Shipments\CalculateShippingCostEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Plugin\ShipmentsPlugin;
use Joomla\CMS\Log\Log;

\defined('_JEXEC') or die;

final class Flat extends ShipmentsPlugin
{
    // The item page: draw the method's name and description.
    public function onItemView($event): void
    {
        $event->setLayout('default_item_view');
        $event->setLayoutData(['method' => $event->getMethod()]);
    }

    // The cart: this plugin has nothing to add beside its method.
    public function onCartView($event): void
    {
        $event->setLayout('default_cart_view');
        $event->setLayoutData([]);
    }

    // The price: the one the merchant typed on the method, or a refusal.
    public function onCalculateShippingCost(CalculateShippingCostEvent $event): void
    {
        $price = $event->getMethod()->param('price');

        if (!is_numeric($price) || (float) $price < 0) {
            $event->setUnavailable($this->refusalKey('NO_PRICE'));

            return;
        }

        // The price as configured. Alfa applies the method's entry mode and taxes.
        $event->setShippingCost((float) $price);
    }

    // The order exists: record its parcel with the charge the order holds.
    public function onOrderAfterPlace($event): void
    {
        $order = $event->getOrder();

        $shipmentId = $this->shipment($order)
            ->pending()
            ->withAllItems()
            ->cost($order->shipmentTotal(), $order->shipmentTotalExcl(), $order->shipmentTaxRate())
            ->save();

        if (!$shipmentId) {
            Log::add(
                'Flat shipping: no parcel was recorded for order #' . $order->id(),
                Log::ERROR,
                $this->logCategory(),
            );
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace Acme\Plugin\AlfaItemFields\Picker\Extension;

defined('_JEXEC') or die;

use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\ItemFields\ItemViewEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Plugin\ItemFieldsPlugin;

final class Picker extends ItemFieldsPlugin
{
    // Declared by having the method: the base class reports it to Alfa.
    public function onItemView($event): void
    {
        if (!$event instanceof ItemViewEvent) {
            return;
        }

        $field = $event->getField();
        $item = $event->getItem();
        $fieldId = (int) $field->id;
        $variant = $item->variant ?? null;

        // A variant field: one dimension of the item's combinations.
        if ($variant && in_array($fieldId, $variant->variantFieldIds ?? [], true)) {
            $event->buyForm()
                ->setLayout('item-radio')
                ->variantSelector($fieldId)
                ->setData([
                    'field' => $field,
                    'values' => $field->values ?? [],
                    'selected' => (int) ($variant->selection[$fieldId] ?? 0),
                    'available' => $variant->availableValueIds[$fieldId] ?? [],
                ]);

            return;
        }

        // An informational field has nothing to choose. This plugin does not draw it.
        if (!empty($field->informational)) {
            return;
        }

        // An option: only the values this item offers as extras.
        $offered = [];

        foreach ($item->options ?? [] as $option) {
            $offered[(int) $option->value_id] = true;
        }

        $values = [];

        foreach ($field->values ?? [] as $value) {
            if (isset($offered[(int) $value->id])) {
                $values[] = $value;
            }
        }

        if ($values === []) {
            return;
        }

        $chosen = array_flip(array_map('intval', $item->selectedOptionValueIds ?? []));
        $selected = 0;
        $available = [];

        foreach ($values as $value) {
            $available[(int) $value->id] = true;

            if ($selected === 0 && isset($chosen[(int) $value->id])) {
                $selected = (int) $value->id;
            }
        }

        $event->buyForm()
            ->setLayout('item-radio')
            ->optionSelector($fieldId)
            ->setData([
                'field' => $field,
                'values' => $values,
                'selected' => $selected,
                'available' => $available,
            ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Acme\Plugin\AlfaFormFields\Reference\Extension;

use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Fields\PrepareDomEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Plugin\FormFieldsPlugin;
use DOMElement;

\defined('_JEXEC') or die;

final class Reference extends FormFieldsPlugin
{
    public function prepareDom(PrepareDomEvent $event): ?DOMElement
    {
        // The base class builds the whole field. Null means: not shown in this form.
        $node = parent::prepareDom($event);

        if ($node === null) {
            return null;
        }

        // Joomla has no form field named "reference". Ask for its plain text input.
        $node->setAttribute('type', 'text');

        if (!$node->getAttribute('autocomplete')) {
            $node->setAttribute('autocomplete', 'off');
        }

        return $node;
    }
}

<?php

namespace Acme\Plugin\AlfaMedia\Webp\Extension;

use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Media\BeforeProcessEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Media\ThumbnailEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Media\ValidateEvent;
use Joomla\CMS\Language\Text;
use Joomla\CMS\Plugin\CMSPlugin;
use Joomla\Event\SubscriberInterface;

\defined('_JEXEC') or die;

final class Webp extends CMSPlugin implements SubscriberInterface
{
    protected $autoloadLanguage = true;

    public static function getSubscribedEvents(): array
    {
        return [
            'onAlfaMediaValidate' => 'onAlfaMediaValidate',
            'onAlfaMediaBeforeProcess' => 'onAlfaMediaBeforeProcess',
            'onAlfaMediaThumbnail' => 'onAlfaMediaThumbnail',
        ];
    }

    public function onAlfaMediaValidate(ValidateEvent $event): void
    {
        $size = @getimagesize($event->getSource());
        $limit = (int) $this->params->get('max_side', 6000);

        if ($size !== false && max($size[0], $size[1]) > $limit) {
            $event->setValid(false);
            $event->setError(Text::sprintf('PLG_ALFA_MEDIA_WEBP_TOO_LARGE', $limit));
        }
    }

    public function onAlfaMediaBeforeProcess(BeforeProcessEvent $event): void
    {
        // Another media plugin already wrote the file.
        if ($event->isProcessed()) {
            return;
        }

        // The main image: no size comes with the event, so the picture keeps its own.
        $written = $this->write($event->getSource(), $event->getDest(), 0, 0);

        if ($written !== '') {
            $event->setFinalPath($written);
            $event->setProcessed(true);
        }
    }

    public function onAlfaMediaThumbnail(ThumbnailEvent $event): void
    {
        if ($event->isProcessed()) {
            return;
        }

        // The thumbnail: Alfa Commerce gives the box it must fit in.
        $written = $this->write($event->getSource(), $event->getDest(), $event->getMaxWidth(), $event->getMaxHeight());

        if ($written !== '') {
            $event->setFinalPath($written);
            $event->setProcessed(true);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Write $source as WebP beside $dest and return the path written, or '' when nothing was written.
     */
    private function write(string $source, string $dest, int $maxWidth, int $maxHeight): string
    {
        if (!\function_exists('imagewebp') || !is_file($source)) {
            return '';
        }

        $image = @imagecreatefromstring((string) file_get_contents($source));

        if ($image === false) {
            return '';
        }

        imagepalettetotruecolor($image);

        if ($maxWidth > 0 && $maxHeight > 0) {
            $ratio = min($maxWidth / imagesx($image), $maxHeight / imagesy($image), 1);

            if ($ratio < 1) {
                $scaled = imagescale(
                    $image,
                    max(1, (int) round(imagesx($image) * $ratio)),
                    max(1, (int) round(imagesy($image) * $ratio)),
                );

                if ($scaled !== false) {
                    $image = $scaled;
                }
            }
        }

        imagealphablending($image, false);
        imagesavealpha($image, true);

        // The name Alfa Commerce proposed, with the extension changed.
        $target = \dirname($dest) . '/' . pathinfo($dest, PATHINFO_FILENAME) . '.webp';
        $quality = (int) $this->params->get('quality', 82);

        return imagewebp($image, $target, $quality) && is_file($target) ? $target : '';
    }
}

<?php

namespace Acme\Plugin\Alfa\Keeplist\Extension;

\defined('_JEXEC') or die;

use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Admin\AdminBeforeDeleteEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Admin\AdminListColumnsEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Admin\AdminListRowDataEvent;
use Joomla\CMS\Language\Text;
use Joomla\CMS\Plugin\CMSPlugin;
use Joomla\Event\SubscriberInterface;

final class Keeplist extends CMSPlugin implements SubscriberInterface
{
    /** This plugin's name, group.element: the first argument of everything it adds. */
    private const ID = 'alfa.keeplist';

    /** Joomla loads the plugin's own language file. Alfa Commerce does not. */
    protected $autoloadLanguage = true;

    public static function getSubscribedEvents(): array
    {
        return [
            'onAlfaAdminListRowData'  => 'onAlfaAdminListRowData',
            'onAlfaAdminListColumns'  => 'onAlfaAdminListColumns',
            'onAlfaAdminBeforeDelete' => 'onAlfaAdminBeforeDelete',
        ];
    }

    /** Once for the page: which of its rows are kept. */
    public function onAlfaAdminListRowData(AdminListRowDataEvent $event): void
    {
        if (!$event->targets('manufacturer')) {
            return;
        }

        $kept = array_intersect($event->getAdminContext()->ids ?? [], $this->keptIds());

        if ($kept === []) {
            return;
        }

        $event->value(self::ID, 'kept', array_fill_keys($kept, true));
    }

    /** The column: it only looks up what the handler above stored. */
    public function onAlfaAdminListColumns(AdminListColumnsEvent $event): void
    {
        if (!$event->targets('manufacturer')) {
            return;
        }

        $context = $event->getAdminContext();

        $context->columns->column(self::ID, 'kept')
            ->title('PLG_ALFA_KEEPLIST_COLUMN')
            ->after('item_count')
            ->setLayout('kept_badge')
            ->setData(
                fn (object $row): ?array => isset($context->rowValues((int) $row->id)['kept'])
                    ? ['kept' => true]
                    : null
            );
    }

    /** Refuse a delete that includes a kept manufacturer. */
    public function onAlfaAdminBeforeDelete(AdminBeforeDeleteEvent $event): void
    {
        if (!$event->targets('manufacturer')) {
            return;
        }

        $context = $event->getAdminContext();

        if (array_intersect($context->ids ?? [], $this->keptIds()) !== []) {
            $context->addError(Text::_('PLG_ALFA_KEEPLIST_REFUSED'));
        }
    }

    /**
     * The ids typed in the plugin's options, for example "3, 7, 12".
     *
     * @return int[]
     */
    private function keptIds(): array
    {
        $ids = array_map('intval', explode(',', (string) $this->params->get('kept_ids', '')));

        return array_values(array_filter($ids, static fn (int $id): bool => $id > 0));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Acme\Plugin\Alfa\Storenotes\Extension;

\defined('_JEXEC') or die;

use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Access\GetAccessActionsEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Menu\BuildMenuEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Panel\PanelDeleteEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Panel\PanelListQueryEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Panel\PanelSaveEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Event\Panel\PanelViewEvent;
use Alfa\Component\Alfa\Administrator\Plugin\TargetedHandlersInterface;
use Joomla\CMS\Language\Text;
use Joomla\CMS\Plugin\CMSPlugin;
use Joomla\Database\DatabaseAwareInterface;
use Joomla\Database\DatabaseAwareTrait;
use Joomla\Event\SubscriberInterface;

final class Storenotes extends CMSPlugin implements SubscriberInterface, TargetedHandlersInterface, DatabaseAwareInterface
{
    use DatabaseAwareTrait;

    /** This plugin's name, group.element: the first argument of everything it adds. */
    private const ID = 'alfa.storenotes';

    /** The one panel this plugin owns. */
    private const PANEL = 'notes';

    /** The permission that opens the panel. */
    private const ACCESS = 'alfa.storenotes.manage';

    private const TABLE = '#__storenotes';

    /** Joomla loads the plugin's own language file. Alfa Commerce does so only on a panel request. */
    protected $autoloadLanguage = true;

    /** Announced to everyone: the menu entry and the permission. */
    public static function getSubscribedEvents(): array
    {
        return [
            'onAlfaBuildMenu'        => 'onAlfaBuildMenu',
            'onAlfaGetAccessActions' => 'onAlfaGetAccessActions',
        ];
    }

    /** Addressed to this plugin alone: the panel events it handles. */
    public function getTargetedHandlers(): array
    {
        return [
            'onAlfaPanelListQuery' => 'onAlfaPanelListQuery',
            'onAlfaPanelView'      => 'onAlfaPanelView',
            'onAlfaPanelSave'      => 'onAlfaPanelSave',
            'onAlfaPanelDelete'    => 'onAlfaPanelDelete',
        ];
    }

    public function onAlfaBuildMenu(BuildMenuEvent $event): void
    {
        $event->item(self::ID, 'storenotes-notes')
            ->section('COM_ALFA_MENU_SALES')
            ->title('PLG_ALFA_STORENOTES_MENU')
            ->panel('alfa', 'storenotes', self::PANEL)
            ->icon('media/com_alfa/images/admin/menu/documents.svg')
            ->ordering(950)
            ->access(self::ACCESS);
    }

    public function onAlfaGetAccessActions(GetAccessActionsEvent $event): void
    {
        $event->action(
            self::ID,
            self::ACCESS,
            'PLG_ALFA_STORENOTES_ACCESS',
            'PLG_ALFA_STORENOTES_ACCESS_DESC',
        );
    }

    /** The list: the whole query, against this plugin's own table. */
    public function onAlfaPanelListQuery(PanelListQueryEvent $event): void
    {
        if ($event->getIdentity()->panel !== self::PANEL) {
            return;
        }

        $db    = $this->getDatabase();
        $query = $event->getQuery();

        $query->select($db->quoteName(['a.id', 'a.title']))
            ->from($db->quoteName(self::TABLE, 'a'))
            ->order($db->quoteName('a.id') . ' DESC');

        $search = trim((string) $event->getState()->get('filter.search', ''));

        if ($search !== '') {
            $query->where($db->quoteName('a.title') . ' LIKE ' . $db->quote('%' . $db->escape($search, true) . '%', false));
        }
    }

    /** Which file draws each screen. */
    public function onAlfaPanelView(PanelViewEvent $event): void
    {
        if ($event->getIdentity()->panel !== self::PANEL) {
            return;
        }

        if ($event->getScreen() === 'list') {
            $event->setLayout('notes.list');          // layouts/notes/list.php

            return;
        }

        if ($event->getScreen() !== 'edit') {
            return;
        }

        $data = $event->getData();                    // id, and what was typed if a save was refused
        $kept = \is_array($data['form'] ?? null) ? $data['form'] : null;

        $event->useForm('note')                       // forms/note.xml
            ->setLayoutData($kept ?? $this->loadNote((int) ($data['id'] ?? 0)));
    }

    public function onAlfaPanelSave(PanelSaveEvent $event): void
    {
        $identity = $event->getIdentity();

        if ($identity->panel !== self::PANEL) {
            return;
        }

        $input = $event->getInput();
        $id    = $input->getInt('id', 0);
        $title = trim($input->getString('title', ''));

        if ($title === '') {
            $event->addMessage(Text::_('PLG_ALFA_STORENOTES_TITLE_MISSING'), 'error')
                ->keepInput()
                ->setRedirect($identity->editUrl($id));

            return;
        }

        $row = (object) [
            'id'    => $id > 0 ? $id : null,
            'title' => $title,
            'note'  => trim($input->getString('note', '')),
        ];

        if ($id > 0) {
            $this->getDatabase()->updateObject(self::TABLE, $row, 'id');
        } else {
            $this->getDatabase()->insertObject(self::TABLE, $row, 'id');
        }

        $event->addMessage(Text::_('PLG_ALFA_STORENOTES_SAVED'))
            ->setRedirect($identity->listUrl());
    }

    public function onAlfaPanelDelete(PanelDeleteEvent $event): void
    {
        $identity = $event->getIdentity();

        if ($identity->panel !== self::PANEL) {
            return;
        }

        $ids = array_values(array_filter($event->getIds(), static fn (int $id): bool => $id > 0));

        if ($ids === []) {
            $event->addMessage(Text::_('PLG_ALFA_STORENOTES_NONE_CHECKED'), 'warning')
                ->setRedirect($identity->listUrl());

            return;
        }

        $db    = $this->getDatabase();
        $query = $db->getQuery(true)
            ->delete($db->quoteName(self::TABLE))
            ->whereIn($db->quoteName('id'), $ids);

        $db->setQuery($query)->execute();

        $event->addMessage(Text::sprintf('PLG_ALFA_STORENOTES_DELETED', \count($ids)))
            ->setRedirect($identity->listUrl());
    }

    /**
     * One note as the edit form needs it. A new note is an empty one.
     *
     * @return array{id: int, title: string, note: string}
     */
    private function loadNote(int $id): array
    {
        $empty = ['id' => 0, 'title' => '', 'note' => ''];

        if ($id <= 0) {
            return $empty;
        }

        $db    = $this->getDatabase();
        $query = $db->getQuery(true)
            ->select($db->quoteName(['id', 'title', 'note']))
            ->from($db->quoteName(self::TABLE))
            ->where($db->quoteName('id') . ' = ' . $id);

        return $db->setQuery($query)->loadAssoc() ?: $empty;
    }
}

        ];
    }

    // Addressed to this plugin alone. The same method a plugin of the Alfa groups
    // has through TargetedHandlersInterface, written here without the interface.
    public function getTargetedHandlers(): array
    {
        return [
            'onExecuteToolAction' => 'onExecuteToolAction',
        ];
    }

    public function onOrderStatusChange(OrderStatusChangeEvent $event): void
    {
        if (!$event->enteredCompleted()) {
            return;
        }

        $order = $event->getOrder();

        // Joomla writes a log category to a file only when a logger was added for it.
        Log::addLogger(['text_file' => 'shopnotes.php'], Log::ALL, ['shopnotes']);

        Log::add('Order ' . $order->id() . ' was completed.', Log::INFO, 'shopnotes');
    }

    public function onGetToolActions(GetToolActionsEvent $event): void
    {
        // The plugin names itself first, as group.element. The surface is the tab of the
        // Tools screen the button is drawn on: a tool without a surface is not drawn at all.
        // A name no tab of Alfa has opens a tab of its own, with surface_label as its title.
        $event->add('system.shopnotes', 'shopnotes.check', 'PLG_SYSTEM_SHOPNOTES_TOOL_LABEL')
            ->meta('surface', 'shopnotes')
            ->meta('surface_label', 'PLG_SYSTEM_SHOPNOTES_TOOL_TAB');
    }

    public function onExecuteToolAction(ExecuteToolActionEvent $event): void
    {
        if ($event->getAction() !== 'shopnotes.check') {
            return;
        }

        $event->setMessage(Text::_('PLG_SYSTEM_SHOPNOTES_TOOL_DONE'));
    }
}
